method.quantile: Original nearest-rank CLI/MCP p95: rank19of20; repair3/rebuild5 p95 equals maximum. Core20 uses original integer-index selection, also rank19.
method.recorder: Original accepted recording adapter, original measured functions, no CPU/wait4 diagnostic hook or new timed bookkeeping
method.isolation_limit: Fresh four-worker native-state proofs at eight boundaries plus reserved execution slot/coordinator isolation, not continuous whole-OS monitoring. Earlier mirror-idle records alone were not native proof; no actual past overlap is inferred.
